verdict.rationale: doola's Registered Agent service, included in all 50 states, receives legal mail and provides same-day scans with secure storage and dashboard access, which covers the core of the story. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that service of process is accepted at a physical street office (it is only implied by 'physical mail' and a 'public-facing address'), service of process named specifically, and independent or hands-on corroboration of same-day scanning.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, service of process is accepted at a real street office and scanned into my account the same day it is received

citations.quote: Receive local document scans within the same day and enjoy secure storage for all scanned documents
Our Registered Agent service enables you to respond quickly by giving you digital access to physical mail via doola's dashboard.
